hardening.needsAdmin: Administrator rights are needed: the app runs without elevation.

browser.applied: Browser protection against WebRTC and DNS leaks is on. Close the browsers completely, background processes included, and open them again.
browser.alreadyApplied: The protection is already in place. If a browser was open, restart it completely.
browser.noneFound: No supported browser profiles were found.
browser.failed: Could not apply the browser protection policy.
browser.notConfirmed: The WebRTC policy did not read back as written. Check the administrator rights.
browser.foreignValue: A policy of this browser is already set with an unexpected value type; the browser was left as it is.
browser.managedNote: A browser with these policies shows "Managed by your organization"; that is expected, and rolling back removes the policies.
browser.cleanupPartial: Some browser policies left by earlier settings could not be restored; the next apply or rollback tries again.
browser.rolledBack: Browser protection was rolled back. Restart the browsers completely.
browser.rollbackPartial: The rollback did not finish. The original values are kept; try again.
browser.notApplied: Browser protection was not applied: nothing to roll back.

location.unreadable: Could not check the {{hive}} registry state. The location settings were not changed.
location.failed: Could not apply the location settings; the changes were undone.
location.foreignValue: A location value is already set with an unexpected type; nothing was changed.
location.rollbackFailed: Could not fully restore the registry settings. The backup is kept.

legacy.browserLeftover: The previous version may have left WebRTC policies in the registry that cannot be restored automatically: check chrome://policy (edge://policy, browser://policy).
legacy.browserFiles: The previous version changed WebRTC settings in browser profiles (Preferences, user.js); they are not restored automatically. If calls do not work in Firefox, reset the media.peerconnection.* preferences on about:config.
legacy.locationLeftover: The previous version may have left Windows location turned off in a way that cannot be restored automatically: check Settings > Privacy > Location.
